title: Best-Spot Ranking by Catch Rate
dataSources: Fishing catches (`fishing:catch`), fishfinder sonar (`fishfinder:reading`), foraging finds (`foraging:find`), game-cam triggers (`gamecam:trigger`).
app: Outdoor logs — fishing apps (Fishbrain), sonar / fishfinder exports, game/trail cameras, and foraging journals — streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=fishing:catch
| stats count as catches, sum(hours_fished) as hours by spot
| eval catch_rate=round(catches/hours,2)
| where hours>=2
| sort - catch_rate
description: Ranks your fishing spots by catches per hour, cutting through nostalgia to show where you truly do best.
value: Catch-per-hour reveals which spots are genuinely productive versus merely familiar, focusing limited time well.
implementation: Ingest catches and hours by spot into `index=personal`; rank by catch rate.
visualization: Bar chart of catch rate by fishing spot.
grandmaExplanation: It ranks your fishing spots by how many fish you catch per hour, showing where you really do best.
